evidence.Medial Meniscus: Complex tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus, extending to the root with a prominent radial oblique component.
evidence.Medial OA: Focal full-thickness chondral loss in the weightbearing portion of the medial femoral condyle with underlying bone stress changes.
evidence.Lateral OA: Marginal osteophyte formation is also noted in the tibiofemoral compartments.
evidence.PF OA: Severe patellofemoral degenerative change with full-thickness chondral loss and underlying bone changes along the lateral retropatellar facet and corresponding femoral trochlea surface, together with marginal osteophyte formation.
